FAN.unsupported: Affinity Nameplates requires Foundry VTT 13 and the Project FU system.

fontFamily.name: Font: Family
fontFamily.hint: Font available in Foundry or your browser, for example Signika. Unavailable fonts use the browser fallback.

fontSize.name: Font: Size
fontSize.hint: Affinity code font size, 8–48 canvas pixels. Icons scale with the font.

textColor.name: Font: Color
textColor.hint: Six-digit hex color for the affinity codes, for example #FFFFFF. Icons retain their supplied colors.

textOpacity.name: Text Opacity
textOpacity.hint: 0% is invisible; 100% is fully opaque. Applies to icons and codes, including their effects.

placement.name: Section and Anchor
placement.hint: Choose the affinity plate side independently of nameplate visibility. Nameplate anchors follow only labels on the selected side; an empty side falls back to the token edge.

spacing.name: Clearance from Names / Bars
spacing.hint: Gap in canvas pixels from the affinity artwork/text to nearby nameplates or bars. Shadows do not add clearance. Use 0–2 for a tight fit. Manual padding is applied after automatic placement.

paddingX.name: Horizontal Padding
paddingX.hint: Final horizontal offset after automatic bar/nameplate clearance. Positive moves right; negative moves left. Fractional values and intentional overlap are allowed.

paddingY.name: Vertical Padding
paddingY.hint: Final vertical offset after automatic bar/nameplate clearance. Positive moves down; negative moves up, including small negative values. Fractional values and intentional overlap are allowed.

shadowEnabled.name: Drop Shadow: Enabled
shadowEnabled.hint: Apply a shadow to both the icons and affinity codes.

shadowColor.name: Drop Shadow: Color
shadowColor.hint: Six-digit hex shadow color, for example #000000.

shadowDistance.name: Drop Shadow: Distance
shadowDistance.hint: Shadow offset in canvas pixels before zoom.

shadowAngle.name: Drop Shadow: Angle
shadowAngle.hint: Degrees clockwise: 0° right, 90° down, 180° left, 270° up.

shadowTransparency.name: Drop Shadow: Transparency
shadowTransparency.hint: 0% is fully opaque; 100% is invisible. Multiplied by Text Opacity.

outlineEnabled.name: Outline: Enabled
outlineEnabled.hint: Outline the icons and affinity codes.

outlineColor.name: Outline: Color
outlineColor.hint: Six-digit hex outline color. Used when disposition coloring is disabled.

outlineUseDisposition.name: Outline: Use Token Disposition
outlineUseDisposition.hint: Use Foundry’s token disposition color instead of the custom outline color.

outlineThickness.name: Outline: Thickness
outlineThickness.hint: Outline stroke width in canvas pixels before zoom, 0–12.

outlineTransparency.name: Outline: Transparency
outlineTransparency.hint: 0% is fully opaque; 100% is invisible. Multiplied by Text Opacity.

shadowBlur.name: Drop Shadow: Blur
shadowBlur.hint: Shadow softness in canvas pixels before zoom. Zero gives a sharp shadow. Blur changes the effect without changing plate spacing or position.

elementSpacing.name: Element Word Spacing
elementSpacing.hint: Space between complete icon/code pairs in canvas pixels. Zero is the most condensed; larger values spread the elements apart.

wrapElements.name: Wrap Elements
wrapElements.hint: Off keeps all affinities on one line. Enable to wrap between complete icon/code pairs at the token-relative width.

token.hint: GM only. Reveal selected non-neutral affinities to players who can see this token. Save to apply. Prototype Token sets the default for future tokens.
